dedupe_keys.name: integrated lysimeter study deep percolation data from saint nicephore quebec

description: Alexandre Cabral and collaborators publish landfill-cover observations from experimental enclosures at Saint-Nicéphore, Quebec. The open Zenodo collection provides CSV and Parquet tables free under CC BY 4.0. Four lysimeters record hourly deep percolation during June 2018–October 2022; soil moisture, temperature and suction are sampled half-hourly. Weather series cover July 2017–December 2022, with some radiation from ERA5, and laboratory tables give density, conductivity and texture. These measurements can calibrate cold-region cover hydrology and landfill-infiltration simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this field collection. Companion 7948797 provides a restricted daily summary for three plots over 2018–2021 and is included in this record. Timestamps may be irregular, and enclosure counts differ across filenames and README descriptions. Sensor layout requires the accompanying construction report. No tables or report PDF were downloaded, gaps filled or hydrological model fitted.
